messages:
maria: Heads-up: We're planning a pre-merge infra deploy window for release/2026-03-infra at 2026-03-25T22:00Z. Need to coordinate provider pin, IAM changes, and rollback criteria. Can everyone ack and call out blockers? :eyes:

alex: Ack. I'll pin terraform provider aws to 5.12.1 in modules/core and leave a comment in the PR. Avoiding latest due to segfaults on m5 GPUs earlier.

sam: Ack. Can we add an emergency rollback flag on the deploy-bot so it skips the release if the plan touches >50 resources in prod? We had noisy apply last quarter.

olivia: Agree on rollback threshold. Also request we mark IAM changes as manual-approval; any IAM diff needs two approvers. I'll open a tiny policy PR.

deploy-bot: [deployment-scheduler] Scheduled pre-merge apply window created: 2026-03-25 22:00Z -> 2026-03-25 23:00Z. Controlled queue: branch-queue/infrastructure. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/infra-premerge

alex: Pushing a small provider pin now: see PR #4123. Will add a lockfile update and a plan output example in the PR description.

maria: @olivia good call on IAM approvals. @sam we can implement the resource-count guard in the deploybot config. It already supports path filters; I'll draft the config and post.

sam: Nice. Also need an explicit step: if terraform plan contains 'create' for google_project or aws_iam_role, halt and require manual approve.

olivia: For the manual steps, can we auto-annotate the PR with 'requires-iam-approval' label? That way the console will show it on release run.

maria: Draft deploybot config snippet:
```
deploybot:
  windows:
    - name: premerge-infra
      start: '2026-03-25T22:00:00Z'
      end: '2026-03-25T23:00:00Z'
  rules:
    resource_threshold: 50
    require_approvals_for:
      - aws_iam_role
      - google_project
```

sam: :thumbsup: Looks good. One more: add a fallback policy to route to dedicated infra pool if queued job waits >5m.

deploy-bot: [alert] If a job exceeds queue wait 300s will attempt fallback to dedicated-pool-1. Fallback will use pinned model: provider aws 5.12.1.

alex: Quick plan snippet from PR #4123:
```
Plan: 3 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ aws_nat_gateway.gw
+ aws_route_table.rt
+ aws_iam_role.crossacct
```

maria: Good. If the plan shows >2 IAM items, we auto-block. Let's set threshold for IAM items to 2.

olivia: Approved. I'll be online during the window for sign-off. Assigning myself as approver for IAM changes.

sam: I'll monitor queue metrics and be ready to trigger rollback. What's our rollback playbook summary? Quick paste please.

maria: Rollback summary:
- If apply fails or we detect 5xx error spike within 10m -> run immediate rollback: revert to last statefile snapshot + apply with 'force=true'.
- If deploybot fallback triggers -> pause further merges and notify #oncall-infra.

maria: Also tagging release notes: https://go/internal/releases/2026-03-infra

alex: :rocket: All set from my side, marking PR ready for merge into branch-queue.

deploy-bot: [info] Queue status: 3 pending, 1 running (ETA 2m). Will enforce configured thresholds on plan evaluation.

olivia: :eyes: I'll approve IAM PR once plan shows only the intended role creation (no unexpected policies).

sam: Oncall will be @sam for the window. Posting paging list shortly.

maria: Thanks everyone. If no blockers by EOD I'll flip the schedule to 'confirmed' and post a brief release note snippet.
